Done. Run `node server.js` and open http://localhost:3000

- `server.js` — zero-dependency Node HTTP server with JSON API, saves to `data/books.json`
- `public/index.html` — form to add books, "currently reading" and "finished" lists, "Mark finished" button
- `public/book.html` — detail page at `/book/:id` showing title, author, notes (shareable link)

All endpoints verified working: add, list, finish, detail page, and 404s.
